title.zh: Claude Code支持MCP Tasks和Elicitations：插件能追踪长任务，中途还能向用户提问
title.en: Claude Code支持MCP Tasks和Elicitations：插件能追踪长任务，中途还能向用户提问

current_state.zh: Anthropic's Claude Code now supports MCP Tasks and Elicitations, enabling plugins to manage long-running asynchronous tasks, keep them running on remote servers after the session closes, and prompt users mid-task via forms, in public beta via CLI 2.1.304+ with adapter support required.
current_state.en: Anthropic's Claude Code now supports MCP Tasks and Elicitations, enabling plugins to manage long-running asynchronous tasks, keep them running on remote servers after the session closes, and prompt users mid-task via forms, in public beta via CLI 2.1.304+ with adapter support required.
